misreadings.quote: He has repeatedly tried to spare his parents, through pleading, hiding and holding back.
misreadings.evidence: "he dragged the bedsheet on his back up onto the couch"; "Gregor, out of consideration for his parents, did not want to show himself by the window"; the only requests he makes in the text are to the manager and to his father, "No request of Gregor's was of any use"
misreadings.explanation: The text shows Gregor sparing his family by hiding and holding back, but never by pleading with them to spare his parents.

result.note: Both versions follow the passage closely (Grete's trembling voice, her shielding her mother, Gregor's thought of springing into her face), with only one slightly overstated detail in the prose version.
